title: GCP High Availability: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: A hospital has a backup generator. And a second hospital in another city. That's high availability and disaster recovery.

scenes.heading: Generator and second hospital
scenes.narration: Two ideas protect services at different scales. High availability spreads across zones in one region. Disaster recovery spreads across regions. Load balancing sends traffic only to healthy backends. Together they survive both small and big failures.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. That's disaster recovery. Use more than one zone. They protect against different things.

items.wrong: DR and HA are the same
